install: NetworkDemo.install: verify source SHA-256, Docker copy, target SHA-256; create private config only if missing
start: NetworkDemo.start: queue 42, bind router LAN IP:9090; fail closed unless actual target queue is ready
stop: NetworkDemo.stop: remove only marked flow rule and stop verified fixture PID; retain mode
remove: NetworkDemo.remove: stop, remove staged executable, config and fixture log; topology.cleanup removes owned namespace

api.bind: router LAN address only; no host publish
api.read: GET /api/state -> JSON mode, queue_ready, accepted, dropped
api.write: POST /api/mode; Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; body mode=accept or mode=drop
api.ui: GET / -> HTML form for ACCEPT and DROP
api.health: GET /health -> 200 only when queue is ready; otherwise 503

flow.rule: target /opt/sbin/iptables -I FORWARD -s CLIENT/32 -d SERVER/32 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j NFQUEUE --queue-num 42
flow.control_exclusion: router LAN IP:9090 and health are not FORWARD client-to-server:8080

diagnostic_only: --api-only intentionally reports queue_ready=false and health 503; cannot prove A14/A17
